_comment: Public 'currently building' notes. No portfolio products, no memory counts, no prices. Home no longer renders this strip.

building.name: Ostium
building.note: Working name. A meta harness: one place to run and check work from several AI coding assistants. In the works; I'll open source it once it works as intended.

building.name: Maestro
building.note: Chooses which AI model handles each task, trying local models first. In the works; I'll open source it once it works as intended.

building.name: Mnemos
building.note: Shared memory on hardware I own, filed by project. In the works; I'll open source it once it works as intended.

building.name: Cortex
building.note: The hub: shared rules and a status screen that says so plainly when something isn't checked.

building.name: Agent Fabric
building.note: Splits a big job into pieces and runs several AI workers at the same time, each in its own copy of the work.

building.name: Forge
building.note: Specialist helpers for each part of a business. A change is only kept if testing shows it's better. No adapters are trained yet.

building.name: Surfaces
building.note: Voice, planner, terminal, and a desktop app. Ostium now covers much of this.
